_comment: Section 5 budgets of VISUAL_UPGRADE_PLAN.md for tools/art/audit_assets.py. Categories are tried in order; the first whose glob matches the repo-relative path wins (fnmatch: * also matches /). triangles = LOD0 triangles over the default scene; texture_px = largest image side. Rows marked provisional have no Section 5 line and borrow the nearest one.

categories.name: distant_tree
categories.note: Distant tree; shares the species atlas

categories.name: near_tree
categories.note: Near tree; shared 2k atlas per species

categories.name: cobble
categories.note: Provisional: not in Section 5; ten scans instanced about 820 times (Stage 3 ships 180 tris, 256 px)

categories.name: boulder
categories.note: Bar boulder and margin rock scans; 1k textures, 2k for two (Stage 3: boulder_01 and boulder_03, the two the camera meets closest)

categories.name: cliff_talus
categories.note: Stage 2 talus from the cliff kit; instanced about 250 times along the aprons, so far below the kit line

categories.name: cliff_outcrop
categories.note: Cliff or outcrop kit piece; at most 12 unique pieces

categories.name: grass_clump
categories.note: Grass clump and flower cards; shared atlases

categories.name: debris
categories.note: Driftwood, stump, log, bark: Stage 3 ground clutter in assets/clutter/

categories.name: character
categories.note: Provisional: no Section 5 line; uses the Animal line

categories.name: kit_materials
categories.note: Stage 6: the shared tiling materials of the built props (one quad per material); props carry kit_* placeholders that scripts/prop_kit.gd swaps for these

categories.name: camp_kit
categories.note: Wave C: the lean-to's draped canvas (a 24 x 18 cloth grid with stakes and lines) and the fire ring of ten separate scanned cobbles round an ash bed; one draw each, measured by GPU A/B

categories.name: building_kit
categories.note: Stage 6: Lambert's stall as one file of named pieces (log walls, frame, canvas roof, counter, shelves, balance, shelf stock) plus its hidden Milestone 10 collision proxies; kit materials, no textures of its own. Wave C: 17,000 for the trading-post shelf stock and wall goods

categories.name: goods_kit
categories.note: Stage 6: 34 shelf goods in one file, each under the 1,500 prop line (bulk sacks and pork at four fill levels); kit materials. Wave C: 20,000 for seamed, eared sacks with painted marks and the yard freight

categories.name: prop
categories.note: Provisional: no Section 5 line; uses the driftwood/stump/log line

allow.assets/wildlife/bear.glb: Legacy primitive animal (29,450 tris); Stage 5 GAP: no acceptable CC0 black bear (owner decision pending)
allow.assets/wildlife/jay.glb: Legacy primitive animal (17,890 tris); Stage 5 GAP: no CC0 jay with rig and clips (owner decision pending)
allow.assets/wildlife/quail.glb: Legacy primitive animal (22,110 tris); Stage 5 GAP: no CC0 California quail (owner decision pending)
allow.assets/miner/intrepid/miner.glb: Hero Intrepid Miner (116,477 tris, 2k maps); protected by the plan. Its atlases and clips also dress the crew kit
allow.assets/crew/crew_kit.glb: Crew kit (Stage 5): the hero miner's game meshes re-cut for the 14 hands and Lambert (107,376 tris with the beard shell; no textures, clips or gear, which come from the miner); one copy shared by every man, LODs generated on import
allow.assets/miner/miner.glb: Legacy miner rig (19,828 tris) kept for clips and tests
allow.assets/expedition/miner_clips.glb: Animation clip carrier on the legacy miner rig (19,828 tris)
allow.assets/mining/miner_clips.glb: Animation clip carrier on the legacy miner rig (19,828 tris)
allow.assets/store/miner_clips.glb: Animation clip carrier on the legacy miner rig (13,812 tris)
allow.assets/camp/camp.glb: Collision proxies for the nine camp props (1,972 tris, never drawn; atlas removed in Stage 6); the visible props are assets/camp/*.glb
allow.assets/miner/pack.glb: Miner's pack (2,436 tris); matches the hero miner
allow.assets/miner/handline.glb: Handline with the 2k camp atlas embedded (48 tris)
allow.assets/miner/rod.glb: Rod with the 2k store atlas embedded (24 tris)
allow.assets/mining/rocker.glb: Rocker cradle (1,516 tris); just over the provisional prop line
